detail: The GLA/UCL LBSM source family materially changes authority/parser from prior Hillingdon heritage point metadata. The public dataset lists a Hillingdon CSV extract and the public map documents SCU/built-block/building-level views plus mean building-volume height sourced from EA LiDAR and Ordnance Survey. Retrieval did not expose the actual Hillingdon CSV row matching title-boundary:33071999, an OS building identifier/TOID/UPRN, an actual building Polygon/MultiPolygon, a fixed-partition canonical_parcel_id binding, or official DEM/DSM raster pixels needed for parcel zonal min/max/mean/max-min. Nothing was fabricated.
